# Trip Leg Output Schema

The output must be a JSON object with the following root structure:

{
"trip_legs": [
{
"leg_id": "string | UUID | optional if generated by the application",
"trip_id": "string",
"user_id": "string",

```
  "leg_sequence_number": "integer",

  "started_at": "ISO 8601 timestamp",
  "ended_at": "ISO 8601 timestamp",
  "duration_minutes": "integer",

  "origin_label": "string",
  "origin_city": "string",
  "origin_postal_code": "string | null",
  "origin_country_code": "string",

  "destination_label": "string",
  "destination_city": "string",
  "destination_postal_code": "string | null",
  "destination_country_code": "string",

  "transport_mode": "walking | bicycle | bike_sharing | public_transport | regional_train | long_distance_train | car | car_sharing | e_scooter | ride_hailing | taxi | other",

  "ticket_type": "single_ticket | subscription | pay-as-you-go | other | none",
  "ticket_class": "second_class | first_class | none",

  "provider_name": "string | null",
  "service_line": "string | null",
  "vehicle_type": "string | null",

  "estimated_distance_km": "number",
  "estimated_cost_eur": "number | null",
  "estimated_co2_emissions" "number | null",

  "is_access_leg": "boolean",
  "is_main_leg": "boolean",
  "is_egress_leg": "boolean",
  "is_transfer_leg": "boolean",

  "wait_time_minutes": "integer | null",
  "transfer_count_before_leg": "integer",

  "generation_rationale": "string | null"
}
```

]
}

## Important Notes

If a stricter runtime schema is provided, the stricter runtime schema overrides this Markdown schema.

Do not generate fields that are not part of the active schema.

Do not omit required fields from the active schema.

Use `null` only for optional fields where no plausible value can be inferred.

`trip_id` must exactly match one of the provided input trips.

`user_id` must exactly match the provided user.

`leg_id` must be unique within the generated output if it is generated by the model.

`leg_sequence_number` must start at 1 for each trip and increase by 1 within that trip.

`started_at` must be earlier than `ended_at`.

The first leg of a trip must start at or very close to the parent trip's `started_at`.

The last leg of a trip must end at or very close to the parent trip's `ended_at`.

The sum of all leg durations for a trip must approximately match the parent trip's `duration_minutes`.

The sum of all leg distances for a trip must approximately match the parent trip's `estimated_distance_km`.

The sum of all leg costs for a trip must be plausible relative to the parent trip's `estimated_cost_eur`.

Do not generate a leg for a trip that is not present in the input.
